price_basis_recommendation: Use constant2020 GBP for the source-reference comparison; current-technology/historical-condition counterfactual, not a nominal2026 supplier quote

battery.review: Unit conflict retained as two cases; do not rewrite source or double count maintenance/replacement included by footnoteO

hydrogen.scope: Old reference output-capacity costs adapted to ITM BOL consumption; hybrid modelling proxy, not modern ITM quotation. Do not combine reserve with explicit replacement.

supported_H2_reference.scope: Supported strike-value reference only; not a commercial sale or eligibility guarantee

modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.source: IEA Global Hydrogen Review2025 executive summary; manufacture and install outside China in2024
modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.price_base_assumption: Treat the2024 observed USD costs as nominalUSD2024 for this reporting scenario; constant-dollar base not explicitly given in IEA summary
modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.denominator_assumption: Electrical capacity inferred from electrolyser context; summary does not label kWe or AC/DC
modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.FX_scope: Ratio of annual EUR-base reference rates; not independently computed annual average of dailyGBP/USD nor executable quotation
modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.cost_scope: Modern generic non-China installed reference, not ITM/UK site quotation; EPC+contingency already included
modern_H2_CAPEX_reporting_scenario.replacement_rule: Do not multiply this installed cost by old BEIS60% stack share; use separately labelled absolute old-cost proxy or separate reserve scenario

discount.scope: No private investor hurdle inferred from public STPR; no risk-free point estimate invented after BoE403
discount.CRF_formula: r*(1+r)^L/((1+r)^L-1), limit1/L at r=0; apply only with common cost/horizon convention

cautions: CPI is a general purchasing-power deflator, not a battery equipment cost forecast
2020 annual FX is a reporting conversion, not future transaction FX guarantee
Use contemporaneously available information for causal actions; ex-post deflation is a reporting adjustment
Do not treat 2012-supported H2 reference as merchant netback or combine mixed price bases
